Record Class ServerConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
forj.http.server.ServerConfig
Record Components:
maxBodyBytes - the largest request body accepted; larger ones get 413
idleTimeout - how long a kept-alive connection may sit idle
shutdownGrace - how long Server.close() waits for requests in flight
public record ServerConfig(String host, int port, long maxBodyBytes, Duration idleTimeout, Duration shutdownGrace) extends Record
Where and how a Backend serves. defaults() suits development; fromEnvironment() reads each setting from a system property or an environment variable, so a deployment configures it without code:
Settings
PropertyVariableDefaultFormat
forj.http.hostFORJ_HTTP_HOST0.0.0.0host or address
forj.http.portFORJ_HTTP_PORT80800 to 65535; 0 picks a free port
forj.http.maxBodySizeFORJ_HTTP_MAXBODYSIZE10MBbytes, or with KB/MB/GB
forj.http.idleTimeoutFORJ_HTTP_IDLETIMEOUT60s500ms, 30s, 2m, or ISO-8601 (PT30S)
forj.http.shutdownGraceFORJ_HTTP_SHUTDOWNGRACE10sas above
A system property wins over the variable. A value that doesn't parse is an error naming the setting, not a silent default.
